(Rajkumari Alias Ranu Ken Vs The State Of Madhya P
 Dated : 04-02-2026
Shri J.P.Mishra - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Vikram Pipple - Public Prosecutor for the State.
Heard on I.A. No.2214/2026, first application under Secti  BNSS for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to appel  Rajkumari.

This appeal assails the judgment dated 10/01/2026 passed   Additional Sessions Judge, Bhind, in ST CIS No.55/2020 whereby,
 has been convicted under Sections 471 and 420 of IPC with maxim  sentence of 3 years RI.
 Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the tria  erred in convicting the appellant and awarding jail sentence.
T  the appellant has already been suspended by the trial Court for  period.
The appellant was on bail during trial, however, she di  the liberty so granted.
Amount of fine has been deposited by he  hearing of the appeal is likely to take some time.
The appellan  all the conditions as may be imposed by the Court. Hence, praye  the jail sentence of the appellant.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the appl prayed for its rejection.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the 2 CRA-1052-2026 parties,
attending facts and circumstances of the case and that short term of sentence has been imposed,
without commenting on merits of the case, I.A. is hereby allowed.

Subject to depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, the remaining jail sentence of appellant shall remain suspended and she be released on bail.
She is further directed to mark her appearance before the Office of this Court on 30.10.2026 and on subsequent dates given by the Office in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
Record of the Court below be called for.
A copy of this order be sent to the concerned Court below for compliance.
